newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT IN THIRD TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT IN THIRD TEST.

text.p: India won the toss on Sunday and elected to bat first in the third and final test against South Africa.
Both India and South Africa made one change each in the squad that played the second test at Calcutta. Both teams have won one test each.
India brought in opener Wokeri Raman in place of Sanjay Manjrekar while pace bowler Fanie de Villiers replaced Allan Donald in the South African playing eleven.
Donald, who suffered an injury during the second test, has returned home for treatment.

India: Wokeri Raman, Nayan Mongia, Saurav Ganguly, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Rahul Dravid, Mohammed Azharuddin, Sunil Joshi, Aashish Kapoor, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble and Venkatesh Prasad. 12th man: Vangipurappu Laxman.

South Africa: Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Herschelle Gibbs, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Brian McMillan, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Lance Klusener, Fanie de Villiers and John Adams. 12th man: Derek Crookes.
Umpires: David Shepherd (England) and Srinivas Venkataraghavan (India). Third umpire: A.V. Jayaprakash (India). Match referee: John Reid (New Zealand).
